method: Byte-copy the observed database; export via official pycolmap from the isolated copy only. Compare all feature, stored pair, frame and rig counts against the immutable run result.
limitations: Prior diagnostic pycolmap Database.open calls modified the first trial database before retention; its exact original bytes are unavailable. Isolated reproduction changes SQLite header counters at offsets 24–27 and 92–95. No original header is reconstructed and no report hash is rewritten.
